_comment: ComfyUI API-format workflow for one concept sketch on FLUX.2 klein 4B (Apache 2.0; docs/licences/flux2-klein-4b.md), the PC route (ILLUSTRATE_BACKEND=comfy) for when the Mac's sketch service is not used. The weights are the ones in D:/AI/ComfyUI-models: diffusion_models/flux-2-klein-4b.safetensors, text_encoders/qwen3-4b-flux2-klein.safetensors and vae/flux2-klein-vae.safetensors. FLUX.1 dev and FLUX.1 Fill are non-commercial and must never be put back here. src/assets/illustrate.ts substitutes exactly three inputs before queueing it: node 6 inputs.text (the positive prompt), node 7 inputs.text (the fixed negative prompt) and node 25 inputs.noise_seed. Everything else is fixed here. klein is step-distilled: 4 steps at cfg 1, so the negative is wired in but has no effect, which is why the style rules are also written into the positive prompt.
